ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution consists of approximately 45% high-intensity (white) and 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patch covering the inner and mid-section of the left lobe; distinct vertical white band on the outer section of the right lobe; dark border spanning the entire trailing edge and central median area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes; pixel-amplitude variations between 5 and 20 pixels in depth, featuring several prominent notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges tapering to sharp, pointed tips (apices) on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Three distinct dark circular pixel clusters located in the central white field of the left lobe; one dark circular cluster in the lower quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible diagonally across the white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosion/notching on the distal tip of the right lobe and multiple deep notches along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark circular spot (approximately 15x15 pixels) isolated in the lower-left white patch region.
